data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean HD painterly 2D game sprite animation concept sheet using the provided manta ray sprite references as visual identity. Canvas is divided conceptually into exactly four equal invisible cells in a 2x2 layout, with NO visible grid lines, NO borders, NO text, NO labels, NO UI. Background must be solid flat #FF00FF magenta only.

Character: same cute but fierce magical manta ray named Youyou. Blue-cyan manta ray body, deep violet crest and small horns, glowing cyan freckles and glow accents, bright expressive eyes, curled tail, compact chibi 2D game avatar silhouette, glossy underwater fantasy lighting, crisp readable edges. Preserve the same character identity, same body scale, stable bottom anchor, and same bounding box across all four frames. Keep full body centered in each cell with generous magenta margin. All wing tips, tail, small water ribbon effects, and glow accents must fit fully inside each cell.

Action: compact tide-surge attack body animation.
Top-left Frame 1 wind-up: wings fold inward, body coils slightly, eyes focused and fierce.
Top-right Frame 2 strike: wings sweep forward like a manta-fin slash, body lunges dynamically but stays centered in its cell; no detached slash arcs.
Bottom-left Frame 3 follow-through: curled tail and a small tight water ribbon swirl around the body, compact and close to the silhouette.
Bottom-right Frame 4 recovery: body opens back toward idle pose with a small fading water shimmer, compact and centered.

Strict negatives: do not add large detached slash arcs, projectiles, hit sparks, impact bursts, dust clouds, weapons, extra creatures, background scenery, frame decorations, visible cell lines, borders, text, labels, or UI. Keep transparent-looking sprite edges against the flat magenta background, but background itself must be solid #FF00FF.
